decisions.record: Writing a limb-darkened disk without an exponent aborts CASA
decisions.inputs: cl.fromrecord for a limb-darkened disk without optionalParameters, then cl.close.
decisions.casa: writeTable stores an empty optional-parameter vector and throws casacore::indexError from the ComponentList destructor, terminating the process (CASA 6.7.6: close aborts); readTable would read out of bounds.
decisions.ours: Leaves the cell undefined, read as the shape's default exponent 0.05.
decisions.rationale: The default exponent is what every undescribed row already reads as.
decisions.impact: Such lists save and reload instead of aborting the process.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: A single spectral index is read past its end
decisions.inputs: cl.addcomponent(spectrumtype='spectral index', index=alpha) on a polarised component, then predict.
decisions.casa: The matrix sampleStokes used by every component prediction has no one-index branch and reads indices 1 to 3 out of bounds; the per-frequency version scales only I (read from source, not probed).
decisions.ours: Reads a single index as [alpha,0,0,0], so fractional polarisation is constant.
decisions.rationale: This is what the matrix sampler's comments describe.
decisions.impact: Polarised components with one index predict Q, U, V reliably instead of scaled by whatever follows the vector.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: `cl.addcomponent` stores four flux values as Stokes
decisions.casa: setflux stores four values with FluxRep::setValue(Vector<Double>), which resets the representation to Stokes, so the values become I,Q,U,V rather than RR,RL,LR,LL (probed with CASA 6.7.6).
decisions.ours: Does the same (owner decision 2026-10-23), including raising for an unknown name or a non-Stokes representation with one value.
decisions.rationale: Scripts get the list CASA would give them.
decisions.impact: A circular or linear four-value flux is silently read as Stokes in both implementations.
decisions.owner_decision: Owner decision, 2026-10-23 (#841), recorded in docs/CASA (C++) bugs.md.

decisions.record: `cl.addcomponent` stores the flux in single precision
decisions.casa: setflux reads values into a Vector<Complex> (single precision), so flux=0.1 is stored as 0.10000000149011612 (CASA 6.7.6).
decisions.impact: Fluxes differ from CASA's by at most 6e-8 relative.

decisions.record: The `cl` tool records a shape's axes in the units it was given
decisions.inputs: cl.addcomponent(majoraxis='1arcsec', ...) then reading the shape record.
decisions.casa: TwoSidedShape remembers the units its axes were set in and records them so ({'unit':'arcsec','value':1.0}); a shape read from a table records arcmin axes and degree position angle.
decisions.ours: Holds radians and records every shape as CASA records one read from a table (arcmin, 0.016666666666666666).
decisions.rationale: The quantities are the same, and the table is the same either way.
decisions.impact: The record's unit and value differ from the input's but denote the same quantity.

decisions.record: `cl.addcomponent` keeps a point for a shape it cannot make
decisions.inputs: cl.addcomponent with a misspelled shape name, a limb-darkened disk, or an axis that is not an angle.
decisions.casa: addcomponent ignores setshape's False return, so the component stays a point and addcomponent returns True (CASA 6.7.6).
decisions.ours: Does the same and logs at ERROR; what setshape raises, addcomponent raises too after removing the component.
decisions.rationale: Scripts that misspell a shape get points, as in CASA.
decisions.impact: A misspelled shape yields a point source instead of an error.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA's behaviour is deliberate or users' results depend on it, casa-rs follows it.
